messages.content: Hey Sam! Saw your raised bed post — those look great. I've been thinking about growing some dye plants for my textile work. Any tips for a first-time gardener?
Thanks! Dye plants are a great idea. Marigolds and indigo are pretty forgiving for beginners. Happy to share some seedlings if you want a head start.
That would be amazing! I'll bring some fabric scraps to the next meetup so you can see what I'm working on.
Sounds good. I'll bring the seedlings. See you there!
Hi! I'm interested in joining your next workshop. Any spots open?
Welcome! We have a few spots open for next Saturday. Sign up at the door or message us here to reserve.
